description: Use this when designing any io.Closer / Close(ctx) / Stop() type, adding background workers/tickers/pubsub listeners, writing integration tests that exercise shutdown, or responding to an sdk-leak-hunter G63 failure. Covers cleanup contracts, goleak.VerifyTestMain wiring, leaky fan-out patterns (errgroup / sync.WaitGroup / context.WithCancel without Wait/cancel), and the shipping rules that prevent regressions. Triggers: goleak, goroutine leak, VerifyTestMain, Close() leak, context cancellation leak, fan-out leak, errgroup leak.
